info.title: Inspecto Control API — v1
info.description: The v1 business-contract surface of the Inspecto control plane (design of record: docs/okf/product/module/processor/plan-control-api.md; provenance: docs/archived-documents/plans-archive/api-contract-design.md; transport spine: W1, shipped 2026-07-06). Contract policy: ADDITIVE ONLY within v1 — never remove or rename a field; deprecations are announced via metadata.warnings with a sunset date. Every response uses the Envelope (success) or ErrorResponse (non-2xx) shape; every request/response carries a Correlation-ID header (issued by the server when the caller sends none). Since API-5 (2026-07-25) /api/v1 is the ONLY business surface (the unversioned routes and their sunset apparatus were deleted); this document covers the as-built exemplar paths, not the whole route table; this document grows per bounded context (see tags) as each context's DTO contract is formalized (worklog W3+). Paths documented here are the as-built exemplars that the contract test (inspecto/src/test/java/com/gamma/control/ApiContractTest.java) pins against the live server. Vendor extension x-probe {path, status} marks a GET operation the contract test executes live.

servers.description: Versioned surface (v1 envelope + structured errors). Personal edition: plain HTTP, localhost. Professional edition: HTTPS behind the WSO2 gateway with OIDC (Keycloak/IAM) — same contract.

post.summary: Create a Space, optionally seeded from a Space Template
post.description: Body {id, display_name?, description?, template?, loadSamples?}. loadSamples: true (LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-12) copies the template's data/samples/<pipeline>/ files into that Pipeline's inbox and runs every Pipeline that then has files waiting, once, and answers samples.pipelines[] = {pipeline, sampleFiles, status: loaded|failed, filesLoaded, filesQuarantined, error?} beside the manifest; the Space stays created whatever a run answers. loadSamples without a template, or with a template that ships no samples (GET /spaces/templates samples: false), is refused 422 and nothing is created. Requires canAdminister, the zero-Space recovery create included (there the IdP admin role resolves through the seeded roles; TEMPLATE-RECOVERY-IMPORT-GATE-1). A template's carried kinds meet the same capability table as /spaces/import; a KPI pack (config/registry/kpis/) also needs canAuthorWorkbench, and each KPI meets the /components/kpi save gate against the template's own Datasets; the first refusal creates no Space (ASSURE-KPI-DEFINITIONS-RESIDUALS-1).

403.description: canAdminister missing on a populated server, or a template KPI pack without canAuthorWorkbench; nothing was created.

422.description: A template KPI refused by the /components/kpi save gate (unknown or shared-away Dataset, a field or timeField not in its Schema, a timeField that is not a date), or loadSamples without a template or with a template that ships no samples; nothing was created.

get.summary: Platform bootstrap — everything the backend owns to start the UI
get.description: One cached, ETag'd call folding edition + feature flags, every config spec, the platform enumerations, the Space list and a session stub (design §6.1) — replacing today's N× config-spec + /spaces round-trips. The ComponentKind / Visualization-Type / $-parameter registries and theme stay compile-time in the SPA (documented boundary — the backend has no authority over them). If-None-Match yields 304.
A versioned metadata resource (W3): the response carries a strong ETag = the content hash; a matching If-None-Match yields 304.

put.description: Optimistic locking (W3): an If-Match precondition against the current content hash yields 409 CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION on a stale write. The new ETag rides the 200 response.

Results are transactional and never cached (no ETag). Only type:sql runs server-side today; structured queries compile to SQL client-side.

post.summary: Redeem an OIDC authorization code (backend-mediated session)
post.description: W6d: the SPA completes Authorization Code + PKCE in the browser, then posts the one-time code here. The backend redeems it against the IAM's token endpoint server-to-server and keeps the refresh token in an httpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookie (inspecto_rt) the page's JavaScript can never read — only the short-lived access token is returned. Public route (a caller redeeming a code has no Bearer token yet); cross-site calls are rejected when -Dauth.origin (or -Dcontrol.cors) is configured. 503 on Personal (no session broker).

200.description: Session established; the refresh cookie rides Set-Cookie.

post.summary: Mint a fresh access token from the session cookie
post.description: Reads the httpOnly refresh cookie, redeems it at the IAM, rotates the cookie, and returns the new access token. A rejected (expired/revoked) session is a 401 with the cookie cleared. 503 on Personal.

200.description: Fresh access token; the rotated refresh cookie rides Set-Cookie.

post.description: Best-effort revocation of the refresh token at the IAM, then clears the session cookies. The optional body {postLogoutRedirectUri} is placed on the end-session URL returned as endSessionUrl. Idempotent — succeeds with or without a live session. 503 on Personal.

200.description: Session ended; the cleared cookie rides Set-Cookie.

endSessionUrl.description: The provider's end-session URL carrying id_token_hint, client_id and post_logout_redirect_uri; present only when the session held an ID token and the provider has an end-session endpoint.

Fires one registered pipeline. On the v1 surface returns 202 + {runId,pipeline,status,skipPostAction,dryRun} and a Location to poll; the legacy unversioned route keeps its 200 RunResult body. Response schemas are otherwise undocumented — see control-api.md §5 for the exemplar-coverage decision.

parameters.name: skipPostAction
parameters.description: Skip the source-side post-action for this fire (PIPELINE-DRYRUN-1). Acquisition still fetches from the remote collector for real, so the trigger proves the pipeline can reach and read its source; a collector.post_action.on_success of DELETE/MOVE/RENAME never touches the remote original; and the ingest write STILL HAPPENS FOR REAL. This is not a preview and not the job framework's ?dryRun=true. Renamed from ?dryRun=true on 2026-09-20. Manual triggers only — cron/event/signal fires are always real.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Dry-run the WHOLE pipeline (PIPELINE-DRYRUN-1 step 5): the cycle lands NOTHING — no partition outputs, no quarantine or backup moves, no manifest, no markers, no audit or commit-log rows, no provenance row, no fingerprint/watermark ledger entries — and every suppressed mutation is logged as 'dry run: would ...' so an operator can read the log and see what the real run would have done. The terminal ConsignmentEvent is still published, MARKED dryRun, so a chained Job runs dry too; every other consumer (alert evaluation, the event-store bridge, event-triggered pipelines, enrichment) refuses and logs instead of acting. Choosing between the two: skipPostAction means 'fetch, but do not ack the remote source' and the ingest write still happens for real; dryRun means 'show me what would happen' and nothing happens. dryRun=true IMPLIES skipPostAction — a dry run that deleted the customer's source file is the worst failure this feature can have. Manual triggers only.

post.summary: Replay one file's rejected records as a new Consignment (EXECUTION-RESIDUALS X4)
post.description: canOperateRuns. Re-ingests the rejected records of ONE file, re-read from the ORIGINAL source file by the reject sidecar's line numbers (values are never stored; the sidecar keeps line, column, reason and a salted value fingerprint, plus the source's size and sha256), as a new Consignment through the normal ingest lane; the file's good records (already landed under eject-and-continue) are not touched. Idempotent per sidecar: a second replay of the same sidecar is 409. 404 unknown pipeline or no sidecar; 400 missing file; 403 a path instead of a bare name; 409 template, already replayed, or the source file changed since its rejects were recorded; 410 the source file is gone; 422 not replayable (non-CSV frontend, no source columns, possibly truncated by rejects_limit). A replay whose Consignment did not complete returns 200 with status FAILED and releases its claim.

file.description: The input file's bare name, as the Files or Quarantine tab shows it

default.description: Envelope-wrapped {pipeline, file, replayFile, batchId, status, records, outputRows, errorRows, error}.

get.summary: List one pipeline's pending COMMIT retries (X1 deferrals)
get.description: Open read. The files waiting on a bounded COMMIT retry, by poll-relative path: attempts, firstFailedAt, lastFailedAt, nextRetryAt, due, lastError, inInbox, readable. keepsRetryState=false means the pipeline has no dirs.status_dir and keeps NO retry state (a failed Consignment is retried every cycle without bound) — not the same answer as an empty list. Bounded by ?limit= (max 500) with truncated + the true total; an unreadable record is listed with readable=false, never a 500. 404 unknown pipeline; 400 a non-integer or negative limit.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped {pipeline, keepsRetryState, note?, policy:{maxAttempts, initialBackoffMs, maxBackoffMs, bounded}, total, truncated, retries[], error?}.

post.summary: Retry one file's COMMIT on the next cycle (X1 deferrals)
post.description: canOperateRuns. Clears the file's backoff ONLY; the attempt count is kept (the response says so), so the cap still bites. Taken under the pipeline's run claim without blocking. 404 unknown pipeline, no retry record, or the file is not in the inbox; 400 missing file; 403 an absolute path or one leaving the poll directory; 409 template, no retry state (no dirs.status_dir), already quarantined, the pipeline is mid-cycle, or the record could not be acted on.

file.description: The file's path relative to the pipeline's poll directory, as GET /runs/{runId}/retries lists it

default.description: Envelope-wrapped {pipeline, file, outcome: rescheduled, attempts, maxAttempts, attemptsKept: true, note}.

post.summary: Cancel one file's COMMIT retries: quarantine it now under retry_cancelled (X1 deferrals)
post.description: canOperateRuns. Quarantines the file NOW under reason retry_cancelled and spends its retry record — it decides the file's fate exactly as exhaustion does; it never merely drops the record (which would restore unbounded retry). Same gates and refusals as retry-now; a second cancel reports already quarantined (409) instead of appearing to act.

file.description: The file's path relative to the pipeline's poll directory, as GET /runs/{runId}/retries lists it

default.description: Envelope-wrapped {pipeline, file, outcome: cancelled, attempts, maxAttempts, quarantineReason: retry_cancelled}.

get.description: PIPELINE-CONFIG-HISTORY-1: every successful save of a Pipeline config snapshots it; the newest 50 are kept. Returns {pipeline, keep, total, versions:[{version, savedAt, bytes}]}. A read: no capability gate, like GET /pipelines/{pipelineId}/graph/raw. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.

get.description: Returns {version, savedAt, bytes, pipeline, id, text}: text is the version's TOON, id the Pipeline id it declares (it differs from pipeline for a version saved before a rename, which restore refuses). 400 for a non-numeric version, 404 for one that is not kept.

post.description: Saves the version's exact bytes over the Pipeline's registered config file through the same content gate every save runs, records the result as a NEW version and refreshes the registry. Returns {pipeline, restored, version, path, findings}. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 writes disabled; 404 unknown/unregistered Pipeline or version not kept; 400 non-numeric version; 422 the version fails today's gate; 403 the registered file is outside the write root; 409 the version declares another Pipeline id (saved before a rename) or a stale If-Match.

post.summary: Compare the storage growth of two or more hosted Spaces
post.description: Admits one ad-hoc space.comparison run over the maintenance_storage series of the named Spaces and returns 202 + runId + a Location to poll (GET /jobs/runs/{runId}). Gated on canAdminister: a cross-Space aggregate read. Nothing is persisted beyond the Run message and a space.comparison.completed signal in the requesting Space. 422 malformed body, 404 an unhosted Space, 409 a comparison already running here.

axes.description: Only these storage axes; every axis when omitted

202.description: Accepted; the comparison is running. Poll the Location.

window.description: A trailing window as of a date: only rows whose field, read as a DATE, is in (asOf - days, asOf] feed every measure and ratio (days absent = no lower bound). asOf is always stated. Gives the recency aggregate its as-of; recency is refused without a window.

ratios.description: num / den of two aggregates as a DOUBLE, NULL when den is 0. The column id is <numId>_per_<denId>.

orderBy.description: ORDER BY terms. A term over a result column (a grouped Dimension or a Measure id) orders by it. A term carrying agg, or naming a Dataset column that is not in the result, orders by that column wrapped in a hidden aggregate (default min) while grouping stays unchanged. The column must be a real, unclassified Dataset column and the spec needs a measure and a groupBy, else 422.

cosmetic.description: Set by a chart for its category order only: honoured on a groupBy Dimension with no agg. For a caller who may not see raw entity keys the server drops a cosmetic term over a masked column and orders by the first Measure descending instead; any other order over a masked column is still refused (422).

post.summary: One day of the Board: a page of grain rows + the day's exact totals and Break summary
post.description: Stateless compute over a saved reconciliation (`id`) or an inline draft (`config`), scoped to ONE day (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09). The day's comparison is computed once (one grain join; totals, pair summaries and the group count from one aggregate over it) and cached in memory per (spec, day, sample, input-file stamps), so a further page or filter of the same day is a cache read (`statistics.cached`). `totals` and `summary` cover the whole day whatever the page or filter.

day.description: The ONE day to compare (yyyy-mm-dd) of each Dataset's temporal column (columns[].role temporal, else dateField); absent = the latest day present on any side. A Dataset with no temporal column is a 422 (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09).

filter.description: Which grain rows the page lists; missing_c only on a 3-way reconciliation.

sample.description: Compare at most this many keys, chosen deterministically (hash of the key); reported in `sample`.

availableDays.description: Days present across the sides, newest first, at most 366.

post.summary: The paged Break sets of one anchor-relative pair
post.description: Stateless compute over a saved reconciliation (`id`) or an inline draft (`config`). Rows always carry the anchor as role `a` and the compared side (`side`: b|c) as role `b`. When the config declares `impact.column` naming a column that is NOT compared, each Break row also carries that column's per-side value as `impact` — summed per key, never compared, so it cannot create or suppress a Break (operator decision 2026-09-25).

config.description: An inline reconciliation config (datasets, keyColumns, compareColumns, impact:{column, currency}, ...).

path.description: Board dimension path: key column -> value.

sample.description: Compare only this many keys - the same deterministic keys POST /recon/run samples; the answer then carries a `sample` block {sampled, size, keys, totalKeys} (RECON-PERF-RESIDUALS-1).

day.description: The ONE day to compare (yyyy-mm-dd) of each Dataset's temporal column (columns[].role temporal, else dateField); absent = the latest day present on any side. A Dataset with no temporal column is a 422 (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09).

200.description: One ReconBreakSet per Break type (all of them unless `type` narrows it).

get.summary: The caller’s effective notification preference grid
get.description: Each cell is the calling Subject’s override when it has one, else the deployment default; source marks which (inherited | overridden). Critical categories are always on. email is off and not editable for a Subject with no verified email claim; webhook is never personal. Personal edition (no Subject): the single grid.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

put.summary: Save the caller’s own preference override (self-service)
put.description: Body {"preferences":[{category, channels:{inApp?, email?}}]}. Writes ONLY the calling Subject’s override, keyed by its stable id; a null cell resets it to the default. Critical categories, webhook, and email-on without a verified email claim are ignored, as is any address in the body — email goes to the Subject’s verified claim only. Personal edition (no Subject): writes the single grid. 503 when the deployment overrides file exists but is unreadable. Returns the caller’s effective grid.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

get.description: The grid every Subject inherits where it has no override (source is always inherited).

get.description: The per-kind maker-checker policy persisted as `approval.toon` in the Space's config tree, plus the read-only facts a policy editor needs: `governable` (the kinds a policy may name), `defaultApproverCapability` and `failedClosed`. Open to any caller (reads are not capability-gated). Default OFF: no file (or no write root) reads as an empty `approval` map with `expiresAfterHours` 168. A file that is present but unreadable or invalid is NOT read as off — it holds every governable kind with the defaults and reports `failedClosed: true`; `approval` is then empty and the held kinds are exactly those in `governable`.

put.description: Replaces `approval.toon` wholesale and returns the policy as GET reads it. Requires canAdminister (not canAuthorWorkbench: turning maker-checker off is the one change an author must not be able to make), and is itself never held for approval. Validated fail-closed: an unknown key, a kind outside `governable`, an `approverCapability` no route demands, `expiresAfterHours` outside 1..8784, a non-boolean flag, or a policy requiring approval on a build with no Authenticator is refused. Lenient scalars: `expiresAfterHours` also accepts its string form (`"168"`), the boolean flags accept `"true"`/`"false"`, and a missing or blank `approverCapability` falls back to `canApproveChanges`. An empty or absent body is refused (422): turning four-eyes off must be explicit, `{"approval": {}}`. With no Authenticator configured the route is refused outright (403), so the policy can never be switched off unauthenticated — Personal edition cannot change it through the API (operator, 2026-09-28). Emits one `approval-policy.changed` audit event carrying the policy before and after.

requestBody.description: Required: an empty or absent body is 422. Send `{"approval": {}}` to turn every hold off.

approval.description: Kind (one of `governable`) → rule. Omitted or empty = OFF.

expiresAfterHours.description: How long a Pending Change waits before it is recorded `expired`.

post.summary: Approve a Pending Change and apply it
post.description: Requires canApproveChanges (the route) and then the kind's `approverCapability` (in the handler). Gates in order: canApproveChanges 403 → no authenticated Subject 403 → write root 503 → `reason` over 500 chars 422 → unsafe id 422 → unknown 404 → MAC does not verify 409 → not pending (decided, withdrawn or expired) 409 → the kind's approverCapability 403 → with `fourEyes`, the author approving their own change 403. The original request is then replayed through the route it was proposed through, AS ITS AUTHOR with their authority re-checked now; only a replay that writes exactly the approved content applies. Decided under a cross-process compare-and-set: of two concurrent decisions one wins, the other is 409.

parameters.description: The Pending Change id, `pc-<yyyyMMddHHmmss>-<6 hex>`; any other shape is 422.

403.description: canApproveChanges or the kind's approverCapability missing; no authenticated Subject (an author and a decider cannot be told apart — Personal, which has no Authenticator, is always refused here); the author deciding their own four-eyes change; or the author no longer holds what the change needs (PERMISSION_DENIED).

409.description: Already decided, withdrawn or expired; integrity check failed; the recorded request is not a maker-checker route; or the target changed since the change was proposed — the change is then closed `stale` (CONFLICT).

422.description: Unsafe id or `reason` over 500 chars (CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED); a replay refused by its route with 422 comes back as that 422 and leaves the change pending.

503.description: Write root unset (CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY), or the store locked beyond the wait bound (STORE_BUSY).

post.description: Closes the change `declined`, unapplied; the target is free for a new proposal. Gates as approve up to and including four-eyes (an author may not decline their own four-eyes change — they withdraw it). Audited as `pending-change.declined`.

post.description: The AUTHOR takes back a change they proposed: it closes `withdrawn`, unapplied, signed and audited (`pending-change.withdrawn`) as a decline is. get.description: Evaluates the `kpi` registry component's Measure over the current `grain` period to date and over the SAME elapsed length of the comparison period (KpiEvaluator), in ONE explicit zone: the KPI's `timezone`, else UTC. A read, so ungated. 503 write root unset · 400 unsafe id or bad `asOf` · 404 unknown or shared-away KPI, and a Dataset that is absent OR unreadable by the caller (the same answer on purpose) · 422 a stored KPI that no longer validates, or a failed relation / DuckDB read.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: The day the period runs to (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD, or an ISO instant read as its date in the KPI's zone. Absent: today in that zone. A future day, one before year 1, or an unplaceable instant is a 400.

post.summary: Create a KPI definition from a delivered kpi Requirement
post.description: An explicit authoring action — delivering a Requirement never creates a KPI by itself. Requires canAuthorWorkbench (403 PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise). The Requirement supplies what Business authored on it: `title`, `target`, `unit`, and the good `direction` read off its `comparator` (>= / > → up, <= / < → down); the body supplies what only a Builder knows. Body keys win. The KPI is saved through the same gate as /components/kpi (KpiRoutes.requireMeasure: the Dataset exists and is readable by the author, the measure field and `timeField` are in its Schema, `timeField` is DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ), then the maker-checker hold, then the write, and the Requirement is stamped `kpi: <id>`. 503 write root unset · 404 unknown Requirement · 422 unsafe id, not a kpi Requirement, an invalid KPI or a Measure that does not exist for this author · 409 not delivered, already created one, or a KPI of that id exists.

200.description: The KPI written — its stored content, with `name` = the KPI id and `requirement` = the Requirement id.

202.description: Held by the Space's Approval Policy for `kpi` — nothing was written, and the Requirement is not stamped until the Pending Change is approved (the approval replays this request).

pendingChange.description: The Pending Change record without its content (id, kind, name, operation, status, author, createdAt, expiresAt, approverCapability, fourEyes, …) — GET /pending-changes/{id} reads it in full.

403.description: The caller lacks canAuthorWorkbench (PERMISSION_DENIED) — Professional edition only.

get.summary: The graph-algorithm catalogue and run limits
get.description: LA separation D-4. The 28 server-side graph algorithms ({id, label, cost, inlineNodeCeiling, params[], needsWeights, needsSource, needsTarget, needsNode, resultKind, engines[]}; `engines` lists "memory" and, for neighborhood, egoNetwork and degreeCentrality, "index"), the hard server `ceilings`, the Space's effective default `defaults` (the `graph_run` settings, clamped to the ceilings; `clamped` says so), the worker `pool`, the `inlineWaitMs` and `resultItems` {limit, default, ceiling, clamped}: the most entries any one list of a run's result carries (the Space's `graph_run.max_result_items`, clamped to the ceiling). A read: no capability.

post.summary: Start a graph run over an Investigation's Working Set
post.description: LA separation D-4. Body {investigationId, input?: "workingSet"|"index", at?, algorithm, params?, weights: "count"|"none", kinds?, budget?{maxNodes,maxEdges,timeoutMs}}. `input` defaults to "workingSet" (today's behaviour, unchanged). With "index" (D-3 step 7; needs the Space setting index.enabled and a current, fitting edge index) the body also takes dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol? (as /inv/projection/neighbors) and, for degreeCentrality only, seeds[1..20]; it runs neighborhood (hops <= 2), egoNetwork or a SEEDS-ONLY degreeCentrality from one pinned index version, at most 20 keys looked up per level, and the response carries source {kind: "index", version, stale, staleReason?, fingerprint} and input {kind: "index", estimated: true, version}. Every case the index cannot serve exactly is a 422 naming the cause (index_disabled, no_index, an unfit mapping or column, index_stale_refused, a non-native algorithm, hops > 2, seeds > 20, `at`, an Investigation that hides entities) - it never falls back to the Working Set; a walk that reaches past the cap is a BUDGET_EXCEEDED run naming it. Gated on canRunLinkGraphAnalysis. A Working Set within the algorithm's inlineNodeCeiling is waited for briefly and answered 200 with the run and its result; a larger one is a 202 with a Location to poll. A run already terminal at submit (BUDGET_EXCEEDED, or a result-cache hit) is a 200. BUDGET_EXCEEDED carries the budget, the measured consumed size and a reason - and never a `result` key. Entity ids in a result are masked per the Space's maskingMode, edge ids included.

200.description: The run, terminal (COMPLETED with its `result`; or BUDGET_EXCEEDED / CANCELLED / FAILED without one).

202.description: Accepted; poll the run at the Location header. No `result`.

403.description: The caller lacks canRunLinkGraphAnalysis.

404.description: No such Investigation, or not readable by the caller.

422.description: Unknown algorithm or field, a bad or missing parameter, a bad budget or `at`, an unknown `input`, or an `input: "index"` run the index cannot serve (the cause is named).

503.description: No write root, or the run queue is full (STORE_BUSY).

get.description: LA separation D-4. `?investigationId=` narrows to one Investigation (404 as a read of it would). Only the caller's own runs, and only those whose Investigation the caller can still read. Views carry no `result`.

404.description: `investigationId` names no readable Investigation.

503.description: No write root.

get.description: LA separation D-4. Status, progress ({work, fraction, known}: `fraction` is the algorithm's own live 0..1 and is meaningful only when `known` is true, else 0 means unknown; a COMPLETED run that reports one shows 1), the budget in force, what was consumed (`elapsedMs` is live while RUNNING and final at the end), `cached`,`exceeded` + `reason` (BUDGET_EXCEEDED), `failure` (FAILED, the exception class only) and, only when COMPLETED, the masked `result`. Each list in a result is cut to the Space's `max_result_items` (top of the canonical-v1 order): `result.truncated` is true when any list was cut and `result.lists.<name> = {total, returned, limit, truncated}` gives every top-level list's full count (a nested list, such as one group, appears only when cut) - a cut is never silent, and the cached result stays whole. A run another caller started, or one whose Investigation the caller can no longer read, is absent.

404.description: No such run for this caller.

503.description: No write root.

post.description: LA separation D-4. The run's starter or an administrator (canAdminister); the run ends CANCELLED at its next checkpoint (a queued run at once). No capability beyond that; the Investigation's read access is re-checked.

404.description: No such run - and the same answer when the caller is neither the starter nor an administrator, or can no longer read the run's Investigation (no existence signal).

503.description: No write root.

get.summary: List the edge/node indexes of the caller's viewable Datasets
get.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. {enabled, indexes, total}: `enabled` echoes the Space's index.enabled (default TRUE since 2026-10-10; an explicit false disables; when on, POST /inv/traversal/recursive-paths answers from a current index within the depth/frontier cap). Each index: dataset, mappingHash, mapping {sourceCol,targetCol,kindCol,timeCol,timeColZone,weightCol,attrCols}, version (the CURRENT one), builtAt, builder, rows (edges per direction), nodes, bytes (all tables), droppedNull (rows dropped for a NULL endpoint), tables {name: {rows, files, bytes}}, versions [{version, bytes, current}] (the retained published versions, newest first; bytes = tables + appended deltas), buckets, deltas (appended file groups the version carries), a `plan` (D-3 step 8: {recommended: none|append|full|compact, appendable, reasons, added, removed, changed + a sample of up to 20 paths each} - what differs between the version and the Dataset now and which build would close the gap; advice only, nothing is built by reading it), and `stale` + `reason` (the Dataset's relation SQL changed, the bucket function differs, or DuckDB's version differs - a stale index is still listed). Only Datasets the caller may view are walked: an index over a Dataset the caller cannot view is absent from the answer. No capability.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Start an edge/node index build over a Dataset
post.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. Body {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, kindCol?, timeCol?, timeColZone?, weightCol?, attrCols?, mode?}. `mode` (D-3 step 8) is `full` (default; rebuild from the Dataset), `append` (add ONLY the input files added since the live version, as a delta, published as the NEXT immutable version; refused 409 when a covered file was removed, superseded or rewritten, the relation SQL or bucket function changed, nothing was added, the Dataset is not a plain row-wise store read, or the version already carries 8 deltas) or `compact` (merge the live version's deltas into one sorted main; refused 409 when it has none). Nothing appends or compacts on its own: GET /inv/index only advises. Gated on canBuildLinkIndex (a build spends compute and disk). The Dataset gate runs first, exactly as for a projection: an unknown Dataset is 404 and a Dataset the caller may not view is the SAME 404. A build whose estimate (rows x 34 bytes x 2) is above the Space's index.max_disk_bytes (0 or unset = no limit) is refused up front with the estimate in the message. One live build per (Dataset, mapping): a second start is 409. Always 202 with a Location to poll; the build runs on its own DuckDB connection and publishes an immutable version under <Space write root>/la-index.

202.description: Accepted; poll the build at the Location header. {buildId, status, dataset, mappingHash, progress, ...}.

403.description: The caller lacks canBuildLinkIndex.

404.description: No such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

409.description: The same index (Dataset + mapping) is already building, or an `append` / `compact` is not applicable now (the message names why and the way forward).

422.description: Unknown or missing field, an unknown mode, a column the Dataset does not have, a bad time zone, or an estimate over index.max_disk_bytes.

503.description: No write root, or the build queue is full (STORE_BUSY).

get.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. Status (QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FAILED), the builder's progress {phase, step, steps}, cancelRequested, `failure` (FAILED: the exception class only, never a message) and, when COMPLETED, `result` {version, rows, edges, droppedNull, nodes, buckets, bytes, totalMs}. A build another caller started, or one over a Dataset the caller can no longer view, is absent.

404.description: No such build for this caller.

503.description: No write root.

post.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. The build's starter or an administrator (canAdminister); a running build is cancelled through the builder (nothing is published, the stage is deleted), a queued one at once. No capability beyond that.

404.description: No such build - and the same answer when the caller is neither the starter nor an administrator, or can no longer view the build's Dataset (no existence signal).

503.description: No write root.

The entity key is returned as the Space masked: token (keyMasked: true) unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities.

The Dataset is re-assessed on the next Entity profile read. post.summary: Add a file to an imported Dataset and run it
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2, DT-5. Raw file body, ?name=, ?mode=replace (default: the Dataset becomes this file's rows; the old data is restored if the run fails) or append (stream imports only). The file must be the import's format and carry the columns it reads. Lands the file, runs the import Pipeline, then the in-run link index and Expectations (DT-16); answers the run summary with rowsBefore, rowsAfter, rowsChanged and replaced, or 202 above import.inline_max_bytes. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 not an import Dataset, or an import of it is in flight; 422 name, mode, format or columns; 413 over import.max_bytes.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file's name (bare)

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: replace (default) or append

default.description: Envelope-wrapped run summary (200) or followed-run record (202).

post.summary: Run now: run an imported Dataset's Pipeline over what waits in its inbox
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2, DT-5/DT-16. Runs the import Pipeline once, then builds the link index and evaluates its Expectations inside the same run; answers the run summary. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 not an import Dataset, or an import of it is in flight.

put.summary: Change an exclusion list's ownership, auto-apply and visibility
put.description: LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-1 phase 4. Body {ownerKind?: admin|analyst, autoApply?: boolean, visibility?: open|restricted, reason}: at least one attribute; a key left out keeps its value. Gated on canManageExclusionCategories. Only a list of purpose exclusion carries these attributes (422 otherwise); autoApply true and visibility restricted belong to an ownerKind admin list only (422 on an analyst one). Appends one list.attributes-changed fact naming only the keys that change; nothing to change answers changed 0 and writes nothing. Held as a Pending Change under an approval policy for kind entity-list. Answers the list as GET /entity-lists/{id} does, plus changed.

200.description: The list after the change, and changed (how many attributes changed).

401.description: No credential (when an authenticator is installed).

403.description: The caller lacks canManageExclusionCategories.

404.description: No such Entity List.

409.description: The list is retired, or the identity fact log moved on concurrently.

422.description: No reason, no attribute, a bad value, not an exclusion list, or an admin-only attribute on an analyst list.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: The Incidents and Cases referencing one Entity, for a key that may be a masking alias
post.description: Body {key, entityType?, investigationId?, status?: open|closed|all, limit?: 1..200} -> {entityType, resolved, reason?, objects:[{kind, id, title, status, severity?, createdAt, matchedOn, via?}], total, truncated, masking:{mode, masked}}. The key (alias, Investigation pseudonym or raw id) is resolved server-side with the /inv/reference-rows rules: an alias only for an Entity Type the masking covers; under that masking a raw key names nothing (resolved=false, no oracle). The Entity Type is, for an alias key, entityType when given (one of the Space's Entity Types in force, else 422; ignored for a raw key), else the Investigation's endpoint type, else msisdn. Same matching and visibility as GET /objects/by-entity; no key is echoed and titles are re-masked. Gates: 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE on Basic (Case history is Standard and up, the investigations edition feature; answered at dispatch), 503 write root, 503 Case management not installed, 422 body, 404/403 Investigation, 422 unsearchable key.

get.summary: List the Files recorded towards a Dataset, with each File's index state
get.description: LA-DATA-TRUST-1 S1. Query: limit (default 100, max 1000), offset, name (case-insensitive substring). One row per File from the Consignment audit trail (status ledger joined to lineage and batches of every Pipeline whose batches wrote the Dataset's stores; the problem Files of such a Pipeline are included): {name, day (event day of its output partition, null when it wrote none), rows (0 for a File read with no rows, distinct from no File), errorRows (null = not measured), ingestedAt (the Consignment commit time as a UTC ISO instant, NOT arrival time), outcome (SUCCESS | PARTIAL | QUARANTINED | FAILED, or the ledger's own word such as PARKED), collector, pipeline, consignmentId, indexState (INDEXED | WAITING | UNKNOWN | NO_INDEX | null when the File wrote no partition file), indexVersion (the live version, when INDEXED)}, newest ingested-at first. Also {assessed, total (after the name filter), offset, limit, days [{day, files, rows}], summary {files, rows, latestIngestedAt, indexed, waiting, unknown, problem} over ALL Files, index {present, version, builtAt, inputsRecorded}, readAt, note}. Index state is matched from the live IndexManifest input files (never guessed from timestamps): UNKNOWN when the manifest recorded no list (past 5000 files or an older build) or its list shares nothing with any File. assessed:false (items empty) when no audit trail attributes the Dataset - never read it as no Files. Gated by the geoLink feature, a write root, and R3 view access to the Dataset (unknown and not-viewable are the same 404). No capability.

200.description: {dataset, assessed, total, offset, limit, items, days, summary, index, readAt, note}.

404.description: No such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

422.description: A limit or offset out of range.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Validate an Open in Inspecto LA link's parameters
post.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 section 4 (roadmap I5). The SPA's /open page sends the link's parameters in the BODY: {entity?: "<type>:<key>", investigation?: id, window?: {from?, to?}, reveal?: boolean}. For a type masked under the Space's maskingMode the key must be the exploration alias (masked:<16 hex>): a raw value is refused 422 without being repeated (get the alias from POST /inv/entities/{type}/resolve). Answers {entity?: {type, key (alias or normalised value), masked, revealed?}, investigation?: {id, title}, window?}. reveal:true on a masked entity returns its raw value only to a holder of canRevealLinkEntities (403 otherwise), audited as LINK_ENTITY_REVEALED naming the alias. Reads no Dataset and persists nothing; no capability for the read itself.

403.description: reveal requested without canRevealLinkEntities.

404.description: The Investigation does not exist or the caller cannot read it (one answer).

422.description: Neither entity nor investigation; a malformed entity; an unknown Entity Type; a raw key of a masked type; an alias this server never minted; a bad window.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Resolve a raw value or an alias to the key an Entity profile URL takes
post.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5 (operator 2026-10-15: a raw identifier never travels in a URL). Body {key: a raw value or an exploration alias}. Answers {type, key, masked}: for a type masked under the Space's maskingMode the exploration alias (masked:<16 hex>) of the normalised key, else the normalised value. Reads no Dataset and persists nothing. Gated by the geoLink feature and a write root; no capability. Rate-limited like the Entity profile. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_KEY_RESOLVED (the key is never recorded).

parameters.description: The Entity Type id.

key.description: A raw value or an exploration alias.

422.description: No key, a key that normalises to nothing, or an alias this server never minted.

post.summary: List the values of an Entity Type that start a graph (the Start box type-ahead)
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-9. Body {prefix?: a raw prefix (empty or absent = every value), dataset?: one Dataset id, limit?: 1..20 (default 8)}. Reads only the type's link-end columns (a source or target of a mapping the Space knows: a Dataset's defaultLinkMapping, a saved view or an index) on Datasets the caller may view, optionally one Dataset's. Answers {type, masked, datasets, items [{value, links (rows naming it in a link column), firstSeen, lastSeen}], distinct (Entities matching), truncated, assessed, reason}, busiest first. A type masked under the Space's maskingMode lists no value and is counted only for an empty prefix. The prefix travels in the body only. Gated by the geoLink feature and a write root; no capability. Rate-limited like the Entity profile. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_SUGGESTED (the prefix and values are never recorded).

parameters.description: The Entity Type id.

get.summary: Read one Entity's profile by raw value or exploration alias
get.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5. For a type masked under the Space's maskingMode the key is the exploration alias (masked:<16 hex>) only - a raw value is refused 422, pointing at POST /inv/entities/{type}/resolve, so a raw identifier never travels in a URL; for an unmasked type the value itself. The key is resolved through the same masking as the exploration reads, then normalised by the type's normaliser. {entity {type, key (the alias when the type is masked under the Space's maskingMode), masked}, firstSeen, lastSeen, activeDays, coveredDays, perDay [{day, rows}], where [{dataset, column, rows}], links {degree, kinds [{kind, count}], percentile, from, assessed, reason}, related [{type, count, keys (aliases when either type is masked)}], dataAsOf [{dataset, dataAsOf}], truncated, assessed, reason}. An Entity seen nowhere answers 200 with an empty where. Gated like POST /inv/projection. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_PROFILED (the key is never recorded).

parameters.description: The Entity Type id.

parameters.name: entityKey
parameters.description: The exploration alias for a masked type; the value (URL-encoded) for an unmasked one.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Window start (ISO-8601 instant with a zone, inclusive), from an Open in Inspecto LA deep link. With 'to', scopes where, firstSeen, lastSeen, activeDays, coveredDays and perDay to the window (UTC, [from, to)) and echoes {window: {from, to}}; links and related stay whole-history. 422 for a malformed instant, one outside 0001-01-01..9999-12-31, or from >= to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Window end (ISO-8601 instant with a zone, exclusive); see 'from'.

get.summary: List the Entity Types in force with their bindings and cached headline
get.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5. {items: [{id, label, normaliser, masked, classifications, bindings: [{dataset, column, role}], headline: {distinct, approximate, rows, dataAsOf, computedAt, assessed, reason}}]}. A binding is every Dataset column whose classification the type claims; role is source / target when the column is a link end of a saved Link Analysis view or a published index mapping, else attribute. The headline is the last computed type profile (cached, never a query on this request): assessed:false with reason 'not computed yet' until the type's profile has been read once. Only Datasets the caller may view are walked. Gated by the geoLink feature and a write root; no capability. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_TYPES_LISTED.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.summary: Read the Entity Type profile: aggregates over every column bound to the type
get.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5. Query: sections (comma list of bindings, volume, shapes, time, lineage, links, relationships; all when absent). {entityType, computedAt, cached, truncated, masking {mode, masked}} plus each requested section: bindings [{dataset, column, role, timeColumn, rows, nonNull, fillRate, distinct, approximate, failNormaliser, assessed, reason}], volume {distinct, approximate, rows, sentinels [{dataset, column, kind: builtin|dominant, value (null for dominant), rows, share}], assessed, reason}, shapes {length [{length, rows}], prefix [{prefix, rows}], prefixLength (e164 3, else 0), charClass {digits, letters, mixed}, sampled, assessed, reason}, time {earliest, latest, perDay [{day, rows, distinct}], missingDays, dataAsOf [{dataset, dataAsOf}], assessed, reason}, lineage [{dataset, pipelines, collectors, files, rows, latestIngestedAt, waitingForIndex, problemFiles, assessed, reason}], links {from (dataset; index once the manifest carries link statistics), kinds [{kind, edges}], degree {p50, p90, p99, max}, hubThreshold, hubs, singleLink, assessed, reason}, relationships [{otherType, dataset, oneToOneShare, maxPerEntity, threshold, entitiesAtOrAboveThreshold, assessed, reason}]. Aggregates only: never a raw identifier (a dominant value is reported without its value; hubs are counted, not named). Distinct counts are over the normalised Entity key and approximate. A section that could not be read says assessed:false with the reason; a read cut by an entity_profile.* limit says truncated:true. Cached by the bound Datasets' input-file fingerprint (a new File invalidates it). Gated like POST /inv/projection: geoLink, a write root, R3 view access per Dataset. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_TYPE_PROFILED.

parameters.description: The Entity Type id.

422.description: An unknown section name.

get.summary: The exclusion lists an Investigation can apply
get.description: LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-1 phase 4. Read-shaped, like the Entity List reads (Space access; every edition, Basic included). Answers {lists: [{id, title, entityType, ownerKind, autoApply, visibility, size}]}: every live (not retired) Entity List of purpose exclusion, category (ownerKind admin) lists first, then by title. Never members: a restricted list shows its size only.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Third-party integration (inbound): open a seeded Investigation for an external record
post.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 section 4, phase 5. A fraud product or case manager hands over its own record and the entities it is about. Body {reference: {system, type? (default alert), id, url?, label?}, entities: ["<type>:<key>" ...], purpose, title?, window?: {from?, to?, ...}, binding?: {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol?, timeCol?, timeColZone?, eventsCol?}}. Each entity is typed by an Entity Type in force; its key is a raw value (sent in the body) or an exploration alias, normalised by the type's normaliser. Without a binding, the first saved Link Analysis view or published index that links a column of EVERY Entity Type the call names is used (its kind and time columns come along); when no single mapping covers all the named types the call is refused 422 naming them, so name one type per call or send a binding. BEHAVIOUR CHANGE for integrators: a call naming several types used to bind through the first entity's type only and seed the rest unbound; it is now refused 422 unless one mapping covers them all or a binding is sent (an explicit binding is never second-guessed). Composes the existing writes: POST /inv/investigations (purpose, R3 Dataset gate), one seed op per Entity Type, an optional window op, and an external reference (trusted:false). Idempotent on (reference.system, reference.id): the Investigation id is derived from them (ext-<32 hex>), so a repeat - or a racing duplicate on any node - answers the SAME Investigation with created:false and adds nothing. Answers {investigationId, created, seeded, reference, link: "/open?investigation=<id>" (the la-app route; the console mounts it at /studio/open), note}. Gated on canManageIncidents; the caller authenticates as any Subject (an OIDC service-account token works). Rate-limited with the expensive Link Analysis class (429: retry, it is idempotent).

type.description: What the record is in that system (default alert).

id.description: The record's id in that system.

url.description: An absolute http(s) URL to the record; never fetched.

window.description: An Investigation window {from?, to?, ...}; needs a time column.

binding.description: The Dataset and link columns, when the Space's views and indexes do not say.

403.description: The caller lacks canManageIncidents.

404.description: The binding's Dataset is unknown or not viewable by the caller.

409.description: This external reference already opened an Investigation the caller cannot change.

422.description: A malformed reference, entity, window or binding; an unknown Entity Type; no view or index links the entity's type; no purpose.

503.description: No write root.

get.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 phase 6. canAdminister. Answers {handoffConfigured, webhooksConfigured, installed, settings, events, placeholders, note}. settings is la-integration.json as stored: handoff {connection, system, authHeader?, template?, caseIdPointer, caseUrlPointer?}, webhooks {connection, signingSecret (a ${...} reference), events}, retry {count, backoff, initialDelayMillis, maxDelayMillis}. It never holds a secret.

403.description: Missing canAdminister.

put.summary: Replace the Space's third-party integration settings
put.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 phase 6. canAdminister. Gates: 403 -> write root 503 -> 422 (unknown key, a connection or system name that is not a safe name, an authHeader the transport or the signature sets, a template placeholder outside the published list, a template over 64 KiB, a signingSecret that is not a ${...} reference, an unknown event, a retry value out of range) -> atomic write. Audited as LINK_INTEGRATION_CHANGED with before/after.

403.description: Missing canAdminister.

422.description: Invalid settings; nothing was written.

503.description: No write root.

get.summary: List the read-only embed links of an Investigation
get.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1. Read-shaped: any reader of the Investigation. {investigationId, enabled, grants[], max}; each grant {grantId, label, issuedBy, issuedAt, expiresAt, status (active|expired|revoked), revokedAt?, revokedBy?, revokedReason?, lastViewAt?, viewCount}. Never a token or a token hash. Expired grants lose their hash here (the row stays).

404.description: No such Investigation, or not readable by the caller (the same answer).

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Mint a read-only embed link to an Investigation
post.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1 (operator decisions 2026-10-12). Body {ttl_hours?, label?, scope?, masking_mode?}: scope is working_set | with_notes | full (default full; the Working Set is always shown), masking_mode is none | typed | all and never looser than the Space's (422), so a link can only be stricter. Gated on canShareInvestigation (no four-eyes) and on the caller being a LEAD of the Investigation; the Enterprise ABAC action `embed` can forbid it. 503 unless -Dla.embed.enabled=true. ttl_hours defaults to the Space embed.default_ttl_hours (72) and is refused with 422 above embed.max_ttl_hours (default 720 = 30 days; a Space may raise it up to 8760 = 365 days), never clamped. A frame allowlist is refused (422): links are link-only. 422 also when the Investigation reads data of a classification in the Space embed.refuse_classifications. Answers {grantId, investigationId, token, url, expiresAt, label, maskingMode, note}: the token is shown ONCE and only its SHA-256 is stored. Minting writes a sidecar, never an op-log entry: the Dossier root and the op-log hash do not move. At most 20 live links per Investigation (409).

403.description: The caller lacks canShareInvestigation, is not a lead of the Investigation, or an access policy denies the action embed.

404.description: No such Investigation, or not visible to the caller (the same answer).

409.description: The Investigation already holds 20 live links.

422.description: ttl_hours outside 1..the Space maximum, an unknown field (frame_ancestors included: framing is a Space setting, not a per-link one), a bad scope, a masking_mode looser than the Space's, a bad label, or a refused classification.

503.description: Embed links are disabled (-Dla.embed.enabled) or there is no write root.

post.summary: Revoke one embed link of an Investigation
post.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1. Gated on canShareInvestigation and on the caller being a LEAD of the Investigation. Immediate: the link answers the uniform 404 from the next request on; its token hash is dropped and the row stays. Idempotent. Links also revoke automatically when their minter loses their lead role, the Investigation's linked Case closes, or the Space's masking is loosened.

403.description: The caller lacks canShareInvestigation or is not a lead.

404.description: No such Investigation or link.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Grow preview: dry-run an expand and answer what it would add (appends nothing)
post.description: LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-1 GE-3. Body = exactly the expand op body the Investigation would append (op optional, expand only): the same validation, budget, fan-out, hub threshold, direction, window, link kinds and index-or-flat read, evaluated against the Working Set, so the counts equal the delta of that expand appended right after on the same data. Seals nothing, appends nothing, emits no event. A body above the four-eyes thresholds is not read: it answers needsApproval: true with null counts and exceeded[]. Gated as the append: canManageIncidents, a lead of the Investigation (others 404 / a non-lead member 403). 503 on Basic.

addsLinks.description: Links the step would add (null when needsApproval).

reason.description: Why the flat Dataset answered, or why nothing was read.

404.description: No such Investigation, or not visible to the caller.

422.description: The expand body is invalid (the same refusal the append gives), or nothing to expand.

503.description: No write root, or Investigations are not available in this edition (Basic).

post.summary: Hand an Investigation's Dossier bundle and findings off to the external case manager
post.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 phase 6. canManageIncidents, lead only. Body {reveal?}; ?at=&snapshots= as the bundle export. Builds the Dossier bundle (masked per the Space's maskingMode unless reveal:true by a holder of canRevealLinkEntities, then masking.mode is revealed), renders the Space's field-mapping template, and POSTs it through the platform egress (registered https Connection, egress allowlist, pinned address, no redirects, Collector retry on I/O, 5xx, 408, 429 under one Idempotency-Key). The case id at handoff.caseIdPointer of the answer is linked as an external reference {system, type case}. Answers {investigationId, delivered, system, externalCaseId, url, linked, status, attempts, masking, seal}.

403.description: Missing canManageIncidents, not a lead, or reveal without canRevealLinkEntities.

404.description: No such Investigation (or not visible).

409.description: No hand-off configured, or the reference list is full.

422.description: Refused before sending (egress denied, unusable Connection, literal token); nothing was sent.

502.description: The case manager failed after the retries, or answered without a usable case id; nothing was linked.

503.description: No write root, or outbound integration not installed.

post.summary: Grow preview for the explorer: what one neighbours step from a set of entities would add
post.description: LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-1 GE-3 / GE-10. Body {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol?, attrCols?, ids[] (or value: one id, the neighbours read's body), drawn? [values already on the explorer graph], direction? (either|out|in|reciprocal), linkKinds?, hubThreshold?, excludeBy? [listIds], filter?, limit?}. Read-only and unrecorded; available on Basic. addsNodes = distinct neighbours outside ids and drawn not removed by a list; addsLinks = their links to ids folded per (source, target, kind, attrCols) as the neighbours read folds them; linksWithinGraph = the step's links whose both ends are already on the graph (between ids, or to drawn), which the explorer adds where its graph does not draw them yet; held = those with more distinct contacts than hubThreshold (default the Space hub_threshold). limit caps the neighbours read; truncated then makes the counts lower bounds. Ids are exploration aliases when the Space masks.

addsLinks.description: Links the step would add (null when needsApproval).

422.description: A malformed field or an unknown column.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Reference Dataset rows for at most 500 entity keys, masked under the Space's maskingMode
post.description: Body {dataset, keyCol, keys[1..500], columns?, investigationId?} -> {dataset, keyCol, columns, rows:[{key, row}], matchedKeys, unresolved (unknown aliases), rawKeysRefused, truncated, masking}. Keys may be aliases/pseudonyms (resolved server-side); under masking a raw key names nothing. Gates: 503 write root, 422 body/columns, 413 > 500 keys, 404/403 Investigation, 404 Dataset not viewable.

get.summary: List the Collectors an analyst may upload to
get.description: LA-I2-GAPS-RESIDUALS-1. The Collectors that opted in with collector.accepts_upload (local poll Collectors): collector, pipeline, includes (the file patterns they pick up) and maxBytes (upload.max_bytes). Needs canUploadData.

post.summary: Land an analyst CSV in an upload-enabled Collector's inbox
post.description: LA-ANALYST-UPLOAD-1. Raw CSV body (UTF-8), `?name=<file>.csv` (bare name, must match the Collector's file pattern), optional `replace=true`. Lands bytes only; the Collector's Pipeline parses, types, masks and quarantines. Needs canUploadData. Refusals: 503 no write root, 422 bad name / not a CSV / empty / zip-XLSX / NUL / not UTF-8, 403 path-shaped name, D-U7 four-eyes row budget, or replace=true on another analyst's waiting upload (only the uploader or canAdminister may replace), 404 unknown or non-upload Collector, 413 over upload.max_bytes or upload.daily_bytes, 409 name already in the inbox, or replace=true while a run of the Pipeline is in flight (a replace takes the run claim like delete), 429 rate limit.

201.description: Landed. Envelope data: collector, pipeline, file, bytes, sha256, replaced, landedAt.

get.summary: List the caller's uploads to a Collector with their ingest state
get.description: LA-I2-GAPS-RESIDUALS-1. The caller's own uploads (every upload for canAdminister), newest first, at most 200. Per upload: file, bytes, lines, sha256, uploader, replaced, landedAt, state (pending | ingested | quarantined | consumed), rejectedRows when the Pipeline wrote a reject ledger (counted up to 10000 rows; rejectedRowsCapped: true when it held more), quarantineReason when the whole file was quarantined. Metadata only - never a row or a header value. Needs canUploadData. 503 no write root, 404 unknown or non-upload Collector, 429 rate limit.

200.description: Envelope data: collector, total, truncated, uploads[].

delete.summary: Withdraw an upload the Collector has not picked up yet
delete.description: LA-I2-GAPS-RESIDUALS-1. Deletes the landed file and its upload record. Needs canUploadData, and the caller must be the uploader or hold canAdminister. Refusals: 503 no write root, 404 unknown Collector, no record of that file (exact name) or another analyst's upload (one answer), 409 the Collector already picked the file up (ingested, quarantined or consumed - its rows stay in the Dataset), a run of the Pipeline is in flight, or the filesystem refused.

200.description: Deleted. Envelope data: collector, file, deleted.

post.summary: Add data: upload a file and get a draft of how to import it
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2. Raw file body; stored in the Space's draft area (data root, _onboard/), never in config. Answers the DRAFT: {draftId, kind, file:{name, bytes, rows}, format:{type, delimiter?, header?, quote?}, columns:[{name, header, type:{value, format, evidence, confidence}, sample}], rows (first 20), entityTypes:{columns:[{column, entityType:{value, classification?, evidence, confidence}}], primary, link:{from, to, kind, time, amount, details} (stream) | identifying (reference)}, limits:{maxBytes, maxRows, maxImports, imports, inlineMaxBytes, excel}}. Every proposed choice is {value, evidence, confidence: high|low}; OF-2: high when every sampled value agrees and the sample has at least 50 non-blank values. Formats (DT-8): CSV, TSV, Parquet, JSON (array), NDJSON; Excel (.xlsx) only when the bundle carries the DuckDB excel extension, else 422 'save as CSV'. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 422 name missing/unusable; 403 a path-shaped name; 413 over import.max_bytes (streamed, never buffered) or more rows than import.max_rows; 422 empty, unreadable or unsupported file. Drafts expire after 24 hours.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file's name (bare; its extension selects the reader)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: stream (events, links; default) or reference (details about entities)

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: Delimited text only: the user's own delimiter (re-draft after a low-confidence proposal)

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Delimited text only: true or false

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Delimited text only: one character, or empty for none

post.summary: Add data: one confirm - write the import Pipeline, run it once, register the Dataset
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2/OB-3/OB-4/OB-8. {fileId} is the draftId. Body (every key optional; absent = the draft's proposal): {name (Dataset and Pipeline id, lower-case), description, columns:[{name (the draft column), type?, format?, entityType? (id or null), rename?, drop?}], primaryEntityType?, link?:{from, to, kind?, time?, amount?, details?[]} | null (stream), identifyingColumn? (reference), format? (must equal the draft's: re-draft to change it)}. Writes imports/<id>_schema.toon (index selectors for delimited files) and imports/<id>_pipeline.toon (an ordinary Pipeline, origin: import, trigger {type: manual}, local inbox, accepts_upload, PARQUET), both through the save gate; registers it, lands the file, runs it once, registers the Dataset {physicalRef <id>/database, origin import, kind, columns[].classification, primaryEntityType, defaultLinkMapping, eventDate, identifyingColumn}, then - inside the same run (DT-16) unless pipeline.automation is present - builds the link index and evaluates the Expectations targeting the Pipeline. Answers the run summary {dataset, pipeline, kind, file, rowsIn, rowsRejected, rejectedDetail?, quarantined:[{file, reason}], rowsBefore, rowsAfter, rowsChanged, replaced, followOnInRun, index:{result, message, code?, edges?, nodes?}, expectations:[{name, status, violations}]}; above import.inline_max_bytes 202 {runId, dataset, action, state, startedAt, poll}. A failed commit leaves nothing behind (config files, registration, data and inbox directories, Dataset entry); the draft keeps its file. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 404 unknown/expired draft (or another person's); 409 the name is taken (Dataset, Pipeline, config files or data directory), an approval policy holds Datasets, the same import is in flight, or import.max_datasets is reached; 422 a choice naming nothing real, a save-gate refusal, or a run that imported nothing.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped run summary (200) or followed-run record (202).

get.summary: Follow an import run answered with 202
get.description: canUploadData. {runId, dataset, action (commit|add-file), state (running|succeeded|failed), startedAt, finishedAt?, summary? (as the 200 commit), message? (why it failed - everything was undone)}. In memory, the last 200 runs; 404 unknown, evicted, or another person's run (unless canAdminister).

get.summary: Read-only embedded view of one Investigation (public; the token is the credential)
get.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1. Anonymous: exempt from platform authentication, authenticated by the embed token in the path; the holder is an EmbedGrant, never a Subject, so it reaches no other route. Answers the masked view {investigation{id,title,purpose,createdAt}, head{step,workingSetHash}, workingSet{entities,links,excludedCount}, annotations, references, link{expiresAt}, masking} - masked exactly as the Space masks an Investigation read (maskingMode), read from the sealed log only. post.summary: Screen subjects against Entity Lists (Match Scores; persists nothing)
post.description: SCREENING-1. Read-shaped (CapabilityManifest exemption): scores each subject's name (folded, look-alike letters mapped, token-set Jaro-Winkler) and identifier (exact under the list's sealed normaliser, prefix/range/CIDR) against the named Entity Lists; returns matches at or above the threshold, best first. A POST so names never ride in a URL. A retired list matches nothing; an expired entry never matches; a masked list's entry is its mask token.

schema.description: {subjects[1..1000]: [{key?, name?, identifier?}], lists[1..20]: [listId], threshold? (0.5..1, default 0.85), maxMatches? (1..20, default 5)}

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {threshold, results[{key, name, identifier, matches[{listId, purpose, entry, method (name|identifier), score}]}]}

422.description: Malformed body, or an unknown Entity List.

422.description: Unknown state.

post.summary: Decide a Screening Hit (confirm, dismiss or escalate)
post.description: SCREENING-1. Gated on canWorkIncidents. open -> confirmed|dismissed|escalated; escalated -> confirmed|dismissed; confirmed and dismissed are final. The body names the hit's current version (optimistic concurrency) and a reason; the transition is appended to the hit's history and audited (never the screened name). Four-eyes: the person who escalated a hit cannot confirm it (409). A confirm opens an Incident for the subject and a Case that contains it (the Case module is not required: the ops module is) and stamps caseId and incidentId on the hit; if they cannot be opened the hit stays as it was (503 when the ops engine is absent).

schema.description: {decision: confirm|dismiss|escalate, reason (1..500), version (the hit's current version)}

403.description: The caller lacks canWorkIncidents.

404.description: No such hit.

409.description: Stale version, a final state, a transition not allowed, a record that failed its integrity check, or the escalator confirming their own escalation (four-eyes).

422.description: Malformed body.

get.summary: Reveal a Screening Hit's raw subject and matched entry
get.description: SCREENING-1-D3. Gated on canRevealLinkEntities, the one grant that already means 'may see raw keys'. A hit stores a classified name or identifier masked, so the raw subject name and identifier are read again from the Dataset the raising Job screened (by the subject key), and a masked Entity List entry is resolved to its member. Returns {id, subjectName, subjectIdentifier, entry, note?}; a field is null when it cannot be located (the row, Dataset, Job or entry is gone) and note says why. Every call is audited as screening.hit.revealed (ids only, never a value). 409 on a record that failed its integrity check.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {id, subjectName, subjectIdentifier, entry, note?}.

403.description: The caller lacks canRevealLinkEntities.

404.description: No such hit.

409.description: The record failed its integrity check.

IdempotencyKey.description: Dedupe a retryable write: a repeat with the same key replays the first response (with Idempotency-Replayed: true) instead of re-running. ~10 min TTL. Applies to any POST/PUT/DELETE.

Correlation-ID.description: The request's correlation id (issued or echoed). Present on every response, legacy surface included.

AuthExchangeRequest.description: The browser-side PKCE artifacts (W6d). The code is one-time; the verifier proves this client started the flow; the redirectUri must equal the one used on the authorize request.

data.description: The operation's result DTO (object or array).

permissions.description: The authenticated subject's resolved capability grants (W6, guideline 13 — verbs, never roles). Present only when the security module attached a Subject (Professional edition, authenticated request); absent on Personal / anonymous requests.

etag.description: Strong ETag of the resource (= its config contentHash) — lands with W3.

warnings.description: Deprecation and advisory notices (contract-evolution channel, guideline 33).

Links.description: Hypermedia (guideline 12). 'related' is derived from the R1 refs graph (ComponentKind.deriveRefs), never hand-authored — lands with W3.

ErrorObject.description: The structured v1 error (design §5). 'technicalMessage', 'suggestedAction' and 'documentation' are additive per-route enrichments.

Signal.description: One emitted operational fact — the unit of the Signal network (R4; GLOSSARY §8). Events, Alerts and Notifications are projections/consumers of the one signal ledger, never parallel stores. Serves the Signals & Notifications context (streamed as SSE events on /signals/stream when that context lands).

rejectedRows.description: Rows where some non-blank field failed its cast (bounded).

ConnectionProfile.description: Secret-masked wire shape (ConnectionProfile.toMap). Secrets are '${ENV:…}' references at rest and '***' on the wire; the '***' sentinel on write preserves the stored reference.

password.description: Always the mask ('***') on the wire.

options.description: Connector options; secret-looking keys are masked.

content.description: The component's config (name stamped to match the id).

edition.description: The edition (LA-EDITIONS-1 ED-2): basic (auth-free), standard (an Authenticator), advanced (+ the policy engine). Preview reports as advanced.

investigations.description: True only when the Link Analysis Investigation surface is installed AND included in this edition AND the install holds the Investigations add-on (false on Basic, the Link Analysis explorer, and on an install with -Daddons.laInvestigations=false: its Investigation routes answer 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE). parameters.description: Caller values for the query's declared $-parameters (name → value), overriding declared defaults.

KpiWindow.description: A KPI period in the KPI's zone: `from` inclusive, `to` EXCLUSIVE (a month read on the 13th is from the 1st to the 14th).

KpiBands.description: RAG bands. Direction up/down: two thresholds — up is green at or above `green`, amber at or above `amber` (amber <= green); down mirrors it. Direction band: two [lo, hi] intervals, the green one inside the amber one. Outside amber is RED.

measure.description: count, or agg(field) with agg one of MeasureCompiler.AGGS.

timeField.description: The DATE / TIMESTAMP / TIMESTAMPTZ column a period is cut on.

timezone.description: An IANA region zone (e.g. Asia/Kolkata); offset forms are refused. Absent: UTC.

asOf.description: Opt in to a period that follows the data: `latest` evaluates as of the newest day present in `timeField` (never past today) when the request carries no `asOf`. Absent: today. Anything else is a 422.

requirement.description: The kpi Requirement this KPI was created from (POST /requirements/{id}/kpi).

Merged over what the Requirement supplies (title, target, unit, direction from its comparator); body keys win. `dataset`, `measure`, `timeField` and `grain` are required of the merged KPI, and the Requirement supplies none of them.

id.description: The KPI id. Default: the Requirement's id.

direction.description: Overrides the direction read off the Requirement's comparator.

timezone.description: The zone the periods were cut in (the region id `UTC` by default).

comparisonPeriod.description: The same elapsed length of the comparison period; null for comparison `none`.

deltaPct.description: (value - comparisonValue) / |comparisonValue| × 100; with a zero comparison value it is 0 when the value is also 0, else null.

tone.description: The band as a statusTone word; neutral when there is no band.

ReconBreakSet.description: One paged Break set of POST /recon/breaks.

ReconBreak.description: One Break at the key-column grain. `a` = anchor, `b` = compared side; a missing_right row carries `a` only, a missing_left row `b` only.

a.description: The anchor's compared values by column (plus `__records` when the record count is compared).

b.description: The compared side's values, shaped like `a`.

impact.description: Present only when `impact.column` is NOT a compare column: that column's per-side value (SUM per key, cast to DOUBLE), carried and never compared. A side absent at the key, or whose Dataset lacks the column, is null.

PendingChange.description: A Pending Change without its content — what the list, and every decision, returns.

kind.description: The Approval Policy kind (config type or component kind).

name.description: The target's name within its kind.

status.description: `pending` until decided; `approved` (applied), `declined`, `withdrawn` (by its author), `expired`, `stale` (its base moved) are terminal; `invalid` = the record's MAC does not verify.

author.description: The Subject id that proposed it.

authorCapabilities.description: For the reviewer only — apply re-resolves the author's roles as they are then.

baseVersion.description: Content hash of what it replaces; `absent` for a create.

proposedVersion.description: Content hash of what it writes; `absent` for a delete.

decidedBy.description: Who closed it — the approver, decliner, the author on a withdraw, `system` on expiry.

mac.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the record, keyed outside the config tree.

integrity.description: Present only when the MAC does not verify.

current.description: The content it replaces; null for a create.

proposed.description: The content it writes; null for a delete.

required.description: Whether a change to this kind is held as a Pending Change until approved.

approverCapability.description: The capability an approver must hold; must be one some route demands. Missing or blank falls back to `canApproveChanges`.

fourEyes.description: Whether the approver must be someone other than the author.

failedClosed.description: True when `approval.toon` exists but could not be read — `approval` is then empty and every kind in `governable` is held with the defaults.

governable.description: The kinds a policy may name (read-only).

defaultApproverCapability.description: The approverCapability a rule gets when it names none (read-only).

total.description: Every matching change, however many were returned.

coarse.description: True when the middle was too large to tabulate and is shown as a whole replacement.

reason.description: Recorded as `decisionReason` and on the audit row.

applied.description: True only for an approval that wrote.

result.description: Approve only: the replayed route's own answer.

PathJail.description: A resolved path escapes the write root (PATH_JAIL_VIOLATION). Under Professional, 403 also carries PERMISSION_DENIED for authorization denials.

Conflict.description: Resource conflict — duplicate id, in-use referent, or overwrite refused (CONFLICT).

ValidationFailed.description: Spec/safety validation failed (CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED); error.details carries the findings.

NotModified.description: Resource unchanged since the client's cached copy (If-None-Match matched the current ETag) — 304, no body.

StaleVersion.description: An If-Match write precondition failed — the resource changed since it was read (CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION); re-read and retry.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing or invalid credentials (UNAUTHENTICATED) — Professional edition only; Personal never emits it.

SessionUnavailable.description: No session broker on this edition (CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE) — the /auth/* routes are live only when the Professional security module is bundled.

oidc.description: Professional/Enterprise editions only (W6): IAM-issued JWT validated by the resource server (issuer/audience/expiry via JWKS); authorization derived from claims → Roles → Capabilities.
